purpose_zh: 区域协同矩阵机器可读版：五方协同的任务、要素、回路与主体
purpose_en: Machine-readable regional collaboration matrix: tasks, elements, loops and bodies for five partners
boundary_zh: 协同为可核查的任务/要素/运营清单，非愿景口号；正式执行机制待签署合作协议后形成
boundary_en: Collaboration is a verifiable task/element/loop list, not a vision statement; formal execution awaits partnership agreements

partners.task_zh: 商务服务疏解与通勤联动
partners.element_zh: 慢行接驳、共享公服、就业互补
partners.loop_zh: 通勤OD分析→慢行接驳→共享服务
partners.loop_en: Commute OD analysis → slow-traffic → shared services

partners.element_zh: 科研院所成果、验证场景、人才共享
partners.element_en: R&D outcomes, validation scenarios, talent sharing
partners.loop_zh: 成果清单→联合验证→场景落地
partners.loop_en: Outcome list → joint validation → scenario deployment
partners.body_zh: 未来科学城管委会+本方案

partners.element_zh: 基础研究、算力协同、交叉社区
partners.element_en: Basic research, compute synergy, crossover community
partners.loop_zh: 议题共设→联合攻关→成果回馈
partners.loop_en: Topic co-design → joint research → outcome feedback
partners.body_zh: 怀柔科学城管委会+本方案

partners.element_zh: 制造场景、供应链、产线测试
partners.element_en: Manufacturing scenarios, supply chain, production testing
partners.loop_zh: 场景推送→产线测试→数据回流
partners.loop_en: Scenario push → production test → data return

partners.task_zh: 产业链协同与跨域调度
partners.element_zh: 产业分工、要素流动、标准互认
partners.element_en: Division of labor, factor flow, standard mutual recognition
partners.loop_zh: 分工清单→要素配置→标准互认
partners.loop_en: Division list → factor allocation → mutual recognition
